name: Parallel Volume Rendering for Unstructured Grids
aliases: Cell-projection rendering with multiplexed asynchronous communication
Parallel volume renderer for 3D unstructured-grid data
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm for visualizing large-scale unstructured-grid data (e.g., tetrahedral meshes) that uses cell-projection, fine-grained pixel interleaving, and asynchronous communication to achieve scalability and load balancing.
summary: Parallel volume rendering for unstructured grids visualizes large-scale data using cell-projection, fine-grained pixel interleaving, and asynchronous communication to ensure scalability and load balancing.
